newsitem.title: USA: Toys R Us slips slightly after earnings.
newsitem.headline: Toys R Us slips slightly after earnings.

text.p: Shares of Toys R Us Inc edged lower on Wednesday after its fourth quarter earnings came in slightly below Wall Street expectations, although the world's largest toy retailer said the outlook for 1997 is "excellent."
Shares slipped 1/4 to 28-3/8 in early trading.

The company posted earnings per share of $1.38 for the crucial holiday quarter ended February 1, 1997, about a nickel lower than estimates. Analysts had expected $1.42 for the quarter, according to First Call and $1.43 according to Zacks Investment Research.
Toys R Us earned $1.32 in the year-ago period.
Company executives were on a conference call with analysts and were not immediately available for comment.
